stem: A DNA mutation results in a protein that is the same as the initial protein synthesized before the mutation. Which statement **BEST** explains this outcome?

options.label: A
options.text: One amino acid substitution does not affect protein synthesis.

options.label: B
options.text: Different codons can be translated into the same amino acid, so some mutations do not affect protein synthesis.

options.label: C
options.text: Only mutations that occur at the chromosomal level change protein function.

options.label: D
options.text: Amino acids have similar functions, so their corresponding proteins are unaffected by mutations.
